reason: Resolve the review's false-positive font-absent findings (t7-c1/c2/c4/c5 + performance): the autoreview is diff-scoped and refuses binaries, so after the Inter WOFF2 was landed as a vendored trunk asset (present at HEAD, git-tracked, build green, verify passes) the reviewer cannot see it and falsely reports it 'missing / build fails'.
